decisive_items: SARS-CoV-2 PCR: initially positive, negative after 3 weeks
SARS-CoV-2 IgG: positive against Spike protein
She also experienced morning stiffness and knee pain, more severe in the mornings and improving throughout the day.
response.rationale: Temporal link to COVID-19 and seropositivity support post-viral arthritis; negative RF/anti-CCP exclude RA and Heberden node without psoriasis is insufficient for PsA.

rejected.why: Negative RF and anti-CCP, normal CRP, absent typical RA pattern
Hebreden node is not specific for PsA and no clear psoriatic skin/nail changes; DIP involvement alone insufficient
